plan.encoding: canonical ASCII TSV with final LF

source_policy.map: Separate available-section reader; unknown encrypted sections remain inaccessible and omitted with coverage. An admitted section with unavailable required bytes fails.
source_policy.dependencies: Complete authenticated liquid tables, WDT and every known-present root ADT; absent MAIN coordinates are normal.
source_policy.failure: Any known-present dependency, conversion, budget or sink failure rejects the complete selection; provisional outputs remain incomplete.

facts: Map byte availability and independent authentication flags
sorted selected maps and converted/present tile counts

verification.both_commands: Metadata preflight before payload allocation, exact coverage/list/tile inventory, strict70374 MAPS and tilelist formats, equal complete tile/list bitsets and counts.
verification.source_authentication: Offline verification checks producer-reported source coverage, not an independent client snapshot.

resume: Same-context incomplete output only; rerun terrain even if sealed and compare retained artifacts through existing Run receipts before finishing. Complete output refuses writes.

limits.meaning: Downward-only API budgets; package/sink reservations subtract from the combined core ceiling. Logical counters are not RSS or all CPU operations. Cap failures do not truncate output.

legacy_preservation: Existing plans, complete-file APIs, historical failures and component formats retain their explicit scopes; catalog equality does not opt into v12.
